data.name: SettingsStartWithWindowsHelp
data.value: Launch OmenCore automatically when Windows starts

data.name: SettingsStartMinimizedHelp
data.value: Hide main window on startup, show only in system tray

data.name: SettingsLiteModeHelp
data.value: Hides advanced tabs by default. You can disable this anytime to restore full controls.

data.name: SettingsHeadlessModeHelp
data.value: Run without main window, only system tray and background services. Useful for servers.

data.name: SettingsSoftwareRenderingHelp
data.value: Use CPU-based rendering to prevent crashes caused by overlays (RTSS, MSI Afterburner). Requires restart.

data.name: SettingsReduceMotionHelp
data.value: Suppress OmenCore's own transitions and animation, on top of whatever Windows' own 'Show animations' setting already does.

data.name: SettingsLanguageHelp
data.value: Language of the interface. Takes effect the next time OmenCore starts; numbers and log files stay in the same format either way.

data.name: SettingsMinimizeToTrayHelp
data.value: Close button minimizes to system tray instead of exiting

data.name: SettingsDisplayScaleHelp
data.value: Zooms the whole interface, text and spacing together. Ctrl with + and - (or Ctrl+0 to reset) changes it from anywhere in the window.

data.name: SettingsQuickAccessHelp
data.value: Choose the middle popup shortcut, or hide it to prevent accidental display-off clicks.

data.name: SettingsQuickPopupHelp
data.value: Show the quick popup on tray click. Disable to open the main window directly instead.

data.name: SettingsTrayTemperatureHelp
data.value: Display live CPU/GPU temperature on the system tray icon

data.name: SettingsCorsairHidOnlyHelp
data.value: Use direct HID access for Corsair devices. May not work for all devices; restart required.

data.name: SettingsCorsairHidOnlyWarning
data.value: Warning: HID-only mode may reduce compatibility with some Corsair devices. If lighting control stops working, re-enable iCUE fallback or install iCUE.

data.name: SettingsTelemetryHelp
data.value: Share anonymous, aggregated counts of Corsair PID success/failure to help us improve device coverage. No device-identifying data is collected.
